title: Does Robustness Improve Fairness? Approaching Fairness with Word Substitution Robustness Methods for Text Classification

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring True Positive Equality Difference (TPED) and False Positive Equality Difference (FPED) to evaluate Equality of Opportunity and Equalized Odds across gender identity subgroups (male, female, transgender, non-binary) in occupation and toxicity text classification tasks. The study also uses LIME to analyze feature importance of gender tokens and applies explicit gender word substitution perturbations.

Measuring Equalized Odds (combining True Positive Equality Difference and False Positive Equality Difference) across sexual orientation subgroups (homosexual/straight, heterosexual, gay, lesbian, bisexual) in toxicity text classification tasks.
